data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word 'lada', meaning 'light' or 'bright'. In Slavic folklore, Lenka is a form of the goddess Lada, who was associated with the sun and light. The name Lenka carries the meaning “Light, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lenka usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lenka belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lenka total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
